notes: Only fields actually observed from a real CodeGraph 1.5.0 run on the pinned commit are populated; every other field is null (not measured), not zero and not assumed. repo_nodes_total/repo_edges_total/db_size_bytes are CodeGraph's whole-repo counters (it does not support --scope filtering the way this comparison needs), so they are NOT directly comparable to RepoWeaver's scope-filtered nodes/edges_total in v0.2.0-gson-core.json — see the 'non-comparable fields' note in the .md report. cross_file_dependent_coverage is the one metric both tools define the same way (share of symbol-bearing files with >=1 resolved cross-file incoming edge) and is the only apples-to-apples comparison point here.
